title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar, Que New Collection | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable towel storage to your bathroom with this 30-Inch wall mount towel bar made from solid brass in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Designed for the Que New collection, it coordinates easily with versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware while keeping towels organized at the sink or shower.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Straight bar design
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors
- Installation hardware included (towel bar, mounting plates, and hardware)

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.5 inches
- Projection: 3 inches
- Overall dimensions: 33 inches W x 3 inches H x 3 inches projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
